proven: The official sources distinguish exact-content timing, public availability, authorship or inventorship, access, derivation, infringement, entitlement and amount.
The local router preserves a report with all merits axes unknown and does not promote a Git snapshot into later legal axes.
Fourteen deterministic Node.js tests pass and the status-quo frame selects EVIDENCE while preserving every legal-adapter axis.
falsified: Within this route contract, a Git commit automatically proves a qualified timestamp, public access, copying, infringement or payment claim.
Within this route contract, functionality-only software overlap is sufficient to make a protected-expression claim review-ready.
Within this route contract, evidence controlled by another actor creates an automatic production duty, adverse inference or burden reversal.
deepest_unknown: Every individual dispute's creator or inventor identity, external knowledge or access, derivation, protectability, authorization, infringement, procedural applicability, remedy, limitation position and amount remain unknown.
why_unknown: The branch contains general official sources and synthetic tests, not the parties, complete artifact chain, internal records, licences, employment facts or procedural record of an individual case.
known_techniques_relevant: scoped production, inspection and secondary-substantiation review
historical_analogues: paper laboratory notebooks and witnessed disclosures
available_tools: qualified timestamp verification as a future evidence input
missing_measurement_capability: No third-party internal access log, development history, source-selection record, licence chain, confidential commercial data or court-ordered production is available in this general public branch.
custom_tool_needed: A case-specific adapter could ingest minimized exact artifact receipts, party roles, licences, employment facts, designated controlled records and amount data without changing the seven-axis contract.
counterhypothesis: The observed similarity or chronology may be explained by independent creation, common public sources, lawful use, an applicable licence, unprotected functionality or another non-infringing route.
next_w_question: For one concrete dispute, which exact protected object and which single later axis can be strengthened by evidence reasonably available to the reporting party?
next_recursive_level: Bind one case-specific artifact pair and actor relationship to the unchanged route contract, then identify the smallest missing evidence item capable of changing one axis.
next_safe_experiment: Use only synthetic or expressly authorized minimized inputs to add one bound fact at a time and verify that no unrelated axis is promoted.
stop_condition: Stop before naming private persons, publishing secrets, recommending a patent filing, asserting copying or wrongdoing, fixing an amount, contacting another actor or making an external legal claim.
critical_proof_condition: A case-specific conclusion requires the exact protected object, applicable legal route, element-by-element facts, authorization or licence state, relevant counterpositions, procedural basis and evidence for the requested remedy and amount.
boundary: Public official-source research and local deterministic repository work; no individual legal adjudication, external communication, filing, account action or third-party system effect.
reopen_trigger: A minimized case-specific artifact record, a newly relevant official decision or legislation, a qualified timestamp receipt, or a consented internal evidence export.
